newsitem.title: JAPAN: Senshu Bank says to write off Y25 bln bad loans.
newsitem.headline: Senshu Bank says to write off Y25 bln bad loans.

text.p: Japan's Senshu Bank Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to write off problem loans worth 25 billion yen in the year ending on March 31.
The Osaka-based regional bank said in a statement that it also plans to largely complete the write-offs, using its operating profits, in the 1997/98 fiscal year.
The bank's problem loans, including restructured loans, will total 64.5 billion yen at the end of this month, it said.

The bank also said it plans to cut its work force by about 400 people to 1,800 by March 1999 by such steps as trimming the number of new employees and promoting shifts of personnel to bank affiliates.
